units.source: External links

An external link is a standard web link targeting for example a website. For example, __TRILIUM_PH_0__https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/South_China_Sea__TRILIUM_PH_1__ is an external link to a Wikipedia page.
To create a link without a custom text:
Press __TRILIUM_PH_0__ in the __TRILIUM_PH_1__Formatting toolbar__TRILIUM_PH_2__, or press __TRILIUM_PH_3__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_4__+__TRILIUM_PH_5__K__TRILIUM_PH_6__:

Since v0.107.0, the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Add link__TRILIUM_PH_1__ dialog opens on __TRILIUM_PH_2__Web page__TRILIUM_PH_3__, in a popup next to the cursor on desktop. Type or paste the address, and optionally a __TRILIUM_PH_4__Link title__TRILIUM_PH_5__; without one, the link shows its address. The __TRILIUM_PH_6__ __TRILIUM_PH_7__Paste__TRILIUM_PH_8__ button at the end of the address field replaces its text with the text on the clipboard. This button is shown only where Trilium can read the clipboard: in the desktop app, and in a browser over HTTPS unless access to the clipboard was blocked.

When you leave the address field, or paste with the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Paste__TRILIUM_PH_1__ button, an empty __TRILIUM_PH_2__Link title__TRILIUM_PH_3__ is filled with the title of the web page; a spinner at its end shows while it loads. A title you type is kept. To turn this off, go to __TRILIUM_PH_4__Options__TRILIUM_PH_5__ → __TRILIUM_PH_6__Text Notes__TRILIUM_PH_7__ and turn off __TRILIUM_PH_8__Automatically retrieve titles for text links__TRILIUM_PH_9__ in the __TRILIUM_PH_10__Features__TRILIUM_PH_11__ section.

__TRILIUM_PH_0__Display as__TRILIUM_PH_1__ inserts the address as __TRILIUM_PH_2__Text__TRILIUM_PH_3__, or as one of the __TRILIUM_PH_4__Link Previews__TRILIUM_PH_5__: __TRILIUM_PH_6__Icon & text__TRILIUM_PH_7__, __TRILIUM_PH_8__Card__TRILIUM_PH_9__ or, for a YouTube video or the address of an audio or video file, __TRILIUM_PH_10__Embed__TRILIUM_PH_11__.
Press __TRILIUM_PH_0__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_1__ or __TRILIUM_PH_2__Insert link__TRILIUM_PH_3__ to confirm.

Alternatively, use __TRILIUM_PH_0__Slash Commands__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and choose __TRILIUM_PH_2__Link to a web page__TRILIUM_PH_3__, which opens the same dialog. __TRILIUM_PH_4__Link to a web page (with icon)__TRILIUM_PH_5__ and __TRILIUM_PH_6__Link to a web page (as a card)__TRILIUM_PH_7__ open it with that display already picked.
A simpler way is to paste the raw link and press space to turn it automatically into a link.

The __TRILIUM_PH_0__ button and __TRILIUM_PH_1__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_2__+__TRILIUM_PH_3__L__TRILIUM_PH_4__ of __TRILIUM_PH_5__Internal (reference) links__TRILIUM_PH_6__ open the same dialog on __TRILIUM_PH_7__Note__TRILIUM_PH_8__. Select __TRILIUM_PH_9__Web page__TRILIUM_PH_10__ at the top of the dialog to create an external link from there.

An address without a scheme, such as __TRILIUM_PH_0__, gets __TRILIUM_PH_1__. The dialog does not insert an address that is not a valid URL, or a __TRILIUM_PH_2__, __TRILIUM_PH_3__ or __TRILIUM_PH_4__ link, since those can run code, and shows the reason under the address field. A URL pasted into the __TRILIUM_PH_5__Note__TRILIUM_PH_6__ field, or picked from its search, switches the dialog to __TRILIUM_PH_7__Web page__TRILIUM_PH_8__. The dialog also opens on __TRILIUM_PH_9__Web page__TRILIUM_PH_10__ when the selected text is a URL.
To create a link with a custom text:
First, type and select the text which will be turned into a link.

Open the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Add link__TRILIUM_PH_1__ dialog as above (via the formatting toolbar, or __TRILIUM_PH_2__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_3__+__TRILIUM_PH_4__K__TRILIUM_PH_5__). The selected text becomes the text of the link, so the dialog does not offer __TRILIUM_PH_6__Display as__TRILIUM_PH_7__.
Alternatively, simply paste (__TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__+__TRILIUM_PH_2__V__TRILIUM_PH_3__) over the selected text to turn it into a link.
Once a link is inserted:
The text inside the link can be changed if needed but the link itself will remain.

To modify the link, click on the link to display the popup and press the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Edit link__TRILIUM_PH_2__ button. It opens the __TRILIUM_PH_3__Edit link__TRILIUM_PH_4__ dialog, filled with the link's address and text, as do placing the cursor inside the link and pressing __TRILIUM_PH_5__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_6__+__TRILIUM_PH_7__K__TRILIUM_PH_8__, __TRILIUM_PH_9__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_10__+__TRILIUM_PH_11__L__TRILIUM_PH_12__ or one of the link buttons. __TRILIUM_PH_13__Save link__TRILIUM_PH_14__ changes the whole link, its text included, and the dialog can also turn it into a link to a note.

To remove a link, click on it, open the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__More actions__TRILIUM_PH_2__ menu at the end of the popup and choose __TRILIUM_PH_3__ __TRILIUM_PH_4__Unlink__TRILIUM_PH_5__. The text stays, without the link.

The same menu has __TRILIUM_PH_0__Open link__TRILIUM_PH_1__, __TRILIUM_PH_2__Edit link__TRILIUM_PH_3__ and __TRILIUM_PH_4__Copy address (URL)__TRILIUM_PH_5__, and __TRILIUM_PH_6__Display as__TRILIUM_PH_7__, which turns the link into one of the __TRILIUM_PH_8__Link Previews__TRILIUM_PH_9__, as does the __TRILIUM_PH_10__Display__TRILIUM_PH_11__ menu of the popup.
Right-clicking a link opens the same menu.

To follow an external link in a note being edited, __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__+click or double-click it, which opens it in a new tab or window, place the cursor in it and press __TRILIUM_PH_2__Alt__TRILIUM_PH_3__+__TRILIUM_PH_4__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_5__, or right-click it and choose __TRILIUM_PH_6__Open link__TRILIUM_PH_7__. On a touch device, touch and hold the link, then choose __TRILIUM_PH_8__Open link__TRILIUM_PH_9__. A link in an __TRILIUM_PH_10__included note__TRILIUM_PH_11__ that is not __TRILIUM_PH_12__Editable__TRILIUM_PH_13__ opens on a click, as in a read-only note.
